# Copilot instructions

All instructions for AI assistants working in this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
at the repository root. Read it in full before helping with setup, running a submission period,
writing `content.json`, or changing code — in particular §0 (non-negotiable rules) and §4
(narrative-writing step).

When writing CERB narrative, attach these files as context:

- `skills/cerb-iap-architecture-internship/references/experience-categories.md`
- `skills/cerb-iap-architecture-internship/references/writing-good-entries.md`
- `skills/cerb-submission-builder/SKILL.md`
- `examples/content.example.json`
- `config/abbreviations.md`
